messages.author: 87096be9e51acd2d
messages.subject: itemGAM error
parts:
Hi, 

I am exploring the use of mirt and IRTs in general for the first time and analyzing a dataset of multidimensional (5 dimensions) Likert-scale data. My model seems to have good overall fit, based on RMSEA and CFI, but item fits are quite poor (more than half of my 20 items, have fit < 0.01). I am trying to use itemGAM to figure out why the fit is poor:

mod_gpcm <- mirt(likert), model, itemtype="gpcm", method="MHRM")
Theta <- fscores(mod_gpcm)
test1 <- itemGAMlikert[,1], Theta)

But this results in cryptic error:

Error in .C(C_pls_fit1, y = as.double(z), X = as.double(x[good, ]), w = as.double(w),  : 
  Incorrect number of arguments (12), expecting 14 for 'pls_fit1'

I don't really know how to proceed from here or what I did wrong - any tips?


Thanks for help,
Tuomas Aivelo

Phil
